knowledge_gaps: The proposed comparison confounds architecture and objective changes. Add gated SASRec with baseline BCE to the baseline, objective-only and gated-plus-softmax variants; compare under the shared 43,200 GPU-second budget.

The historical attention includes the recent window, so both branches may learn the same signal. It does not explicitly distinguish sustained preferences from isolated interactions. Define history partitioning, repetition handling, gate dimensionality, attention scaling and residual initialization.

Negative sampling is underspecified: clarify sampling per position versus shared pools, exclusion using complete training histories versus causal prefixes, variable negative counts, and whether sampling-probability correction is used. Never consult held-out interactions for exclusions.

Reproduction requires optimizer settings, batch size, sequence length, dropout, checkpoint evaluation frequency, stopping rules and budget allocation. Predictor reconstruction and diagnostic compatibility are requirements, but no concrete implementation is supplied.

Raw margins are sensitive to embedding norms and objective changes; the mapped cosine scores correspond to mean cosine similarities near 0.08–0.11 and cannot rule out other representation problems. Use fixed diagnostic negatives and investigate gate saturation and branch redundancy.

The potential and difficulty ratings remain subjective without runtime or integration evidence. Repeated selection on 200 validation users per category also risks validation overfitting; simulator feedback from twenty users cannot establish general improvements in intent or compatibility.

follow_up_queries.reason: Determine whether the additional branches provide distinct evidence and identify reproducible, causal fusion designs and appropriate ablations.
follow_up_queries.query: In SASRec extensions combining recent-window intent with attention-pooled historical preferences, how are overlapping histories, repeated interactions, causal masking, gate collapse and residual initialization handled? Find implementations and ablations comparing recent-only, history-only, fixed fusion and learned gating without pretrained features.

follow_up_queries.reason: Resolve the objective and sampler specification before attributing improvements to harder ranking comparisons.
follow_up_queries.query: For SASRec trained with 32 distinct uniform negatives per sequence position, how do sampled-softmax cross-entropy and gSASRec generalized BCE differ in sampling correction, history exclusion, variable eligible catalog sizes and computational cost? Find equations and implementations distinguishing full training-history exclusion from causal-prefix exclusion.

follow_up_queries.reason: Design a feasible comparison that separates architectural benefit from objective changes while limiting selection bias.
follow_up_queries.query: What experimental methods support compute-budgeted sequential recommendation comparisons using fixed sampled HR@10 evaluation with 200 validation users per dataset and 99 negatives? Investigate factorial architecture/objective ablations, paired user-level uncertainty, checkpoint selection bias and safeguards against repeated validation tuning.
